{
  "up": [
    "Select molecule_chembl_id AS compound_chembl_id, canonical_smiles",
    "From molecule_dictionary md",
    "Join activities a ON md.molregno = a.molregno",
    "Join assays ass ON a.assay_id = ass.assay_id",
    "Join target_dictionary td ON ass.tid = td.tid",
    "Filter td.pref_name = 'Phosphatidylinositol 4,5-bisphosphate 3-kinase catalytic subunit'",
    "Filter ass.assay_type = 'B'",
    "Filter ass.assay_organism = 'Homo sapiens'",
    "Join compound_structures cs ON md.molregno = cs.molregno",
    "Return compound_chembl_id, canonical_smiles",
    "Sort by compound_chembl_id",
    "Limit 0"
  ]
}
